notes: A goal and a routine each require a theme, so keeping one is not a legal outcome: the gesture is then approve-or-abandon. An idea may stay behind theme-less, so that cascade is the one real choice and starts off. The disclosure reaches two levels down, because a deleted goal takes its projects and measures with it, and so does an included idea. An archived descendant is counted like a live one.
